title: George Glasgow, Crawford baptism 14 June 1818; William Glasgow and Janet Thomson

citations.name: George Glasgow
citations.type: George Glasgow, Crawford baptism 14 June 1818; William Glasgow and Janet Thomson
citations.assertion: Proposed identification with baptised child; adult bridge qualified. Birth 8 June, baptism 14 June 1818. Source detail 2:15KCJHH; DGS 8059254, films 1066586/102898; original unavailable in inspected view. Findmypast R_685665034 repeats this index and is not independent. The baptism and census originals and gravestone image have not been inspected; these are provider index/transcript readings. FamilySearch and Findmypast reproduce the same underlying baptism index and are not independent evidence. The later Leicester adult’s exact birthday may derive from the baptism, so it is not counted as independent confirmation. His inspected 1843 GRO marriage index locates a Leicester entry with Mary Ann Norton among the same-page spouse possibilities, but gives no father or father’s occupation. The original marriage is the decisive next test. The memorial’s older George, died 1816 aged 7, cannot be the 1818 child; its reported age differs by about a year from the 1810 baptism and remains unresolved. Some sibling index birth fields contain malformed years and the 1806 John dates conflict; none is silently corrected. William Glasgow-1533, the circa-1795 Glasgow-born weaver with a Janet Thomson wife, remains a distinct comparison rather than being excluded merely for missing fields: the gamekeeper’s 1841/1851 Crawford household, older age, trade, wife and Isabel chronology provide the positive match. No exact vital replacement, mother attachment, profile merger or upstream father is inferred. George Glasgow: Proposed identification with baptised child; adult bridge qualified; William Glasgow: Selected identification of the named father Reviewed 2026-10-31; Crawford family source receipts, reviewed 31 October 2026; private bundle retained.
